briefing: Markets were quiet and slightly negative today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.5%), not a clear risk-on day. Rather than force capital into the market, I picked only FROG, the one candidate showing full multi-signal confirmation, and left the other two open slots unfilled to wait for a genuine risk-on setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and trading volume — all point the same bullish direction at once. A single indicator can give a false signal, but when many agree, it's much more likely that real buying interest (not just noise) is driving the stock.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立的技術指標（例如RSI、MACD、價格走勢及成交量）同時指向同一方向時才進行交易。單一指標容易出現假訊號，但當多個指標一致時，更能反映真實的買盤力量，而非短暫的市場噪音。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no major catalyst, as NASDAQ slipped 0.2% and the S&P 500 fell 0.5% in a quiet, directionless session. With no strong risk-on or risk-off signal, most momentum candidates lacked full confirmation across RSI, MACD, and volume. One standout, FROG, showed all five bullish technical signals simultaneously, making it the clear exception worth acting on.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，無重大消息刺激，NASDAQ微跌0.2%，標普500指數跌0.5%，屬於方向不明的待觀望行情。由於市場未見明顯的風險偏好或避險訊號，大部分具動能的候選股未能同時符合RSI、MACD及成交量的確認條件。唯獨FROG同時出現五項利好技術訊號，屬於今日少數值得進場的例外。

trades.reasoning: FROG shows all five bullish signals (RSI in bullish zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge), the strongest multi-signal confirmation on today's list even though the broader market is neutral.
